title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode1 Making Memories

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Tennis Court

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Captain
rows.Line:
Okay, that's all for today's practice!
Good work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good work today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... That sure was a workout!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I haven't been able to do club stuff much lately since we've been busy doing that show and getting our contracts sorted...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it really is great to get my body moving!)
Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line:
Hehe, it's been a while!
Sorry to drop in out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line: Oh! You came to visit us?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's you! It's been so long!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Oh, Saki! Looks like you're doing well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I am!
Hehe, I'm happy to see you again after so long!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but what brings you here today?
It's great to see you at practice again...!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line:
Well... It's almost graduation for us, y'know?
So, we figured we'd show our faces around here one last time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...
Once you graduate, you won't be coming by to see us like this very much...

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line: Yeah... We'll miss you...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: Hey now, don't give us those sad looks!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: She's right! We came here to take a picture with you, after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A picture?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: Yeah. We're actually putting a photo album together.

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: We wanted one of our own, not just the yearbook!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: We want to be sure that the fun memories we've made will last.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your memories...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Yup! I mean, we'll always be able to remember them if we've got a photo album, right?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Those times we all had ice cream at the convenience store after practice, or took Print Stickers together, all of that.

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: That's why we want to take a picture with all of you today! How about it?

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line:
Of course!
And please send us the picture too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Making sure your precious memories last... That's a wonderful thing to keep in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh yeah, speaking of photo albums...!)
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm, where did I write it...?
I think it was on one of the later pages...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here it is! Number 95 on my “List of 100 Things to Do Once I'm Back in School”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, this really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was right around the end of the school year when I wrote this... They were talking about yearbooks and stuff on TV, and I really wanted one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't hang out with friends while I was in the hospital, so... I also wished I could make enough memories one day to put together an album...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But now... I've made lots of fun memories.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Playing in a band with Ichi and the others, studying in a classroom with everyone, not to mention participating in every school event, like the Seaside School and the field trip...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: We want to be sure that the fun memories we've made will last.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also wanna treasure the memories I've made with everyone forever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna make my very own album just like my seniors!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but... There are still some things left to do on my list.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like, “Have a sleepover and fall asleep while chatting!” and “Eat crepes on Takeue Street”... I bet it'd be fun to do these with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I did have a sleepover with Ichi and the others a while ago, but we stayed up until morning that time, so we'll have to do it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I always wanted to do that thing where you ask your friends, “Hey, are you still awake?”♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I'm making an album, I should do all this stuff and take pictures for it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... About how many things are there left to do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One, two, three... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Take classes with everyone for a year.” Hehehe, this one deserves a biiig check mark♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Make a lot of friends” is also done...
And I went to Yokohama on the field trip, so I'll give “Go someplace far away to have fun” a check!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I haven't been looking at this notebook much since I've been busy with band stuff lately, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look how many things I wanted to do that I've accomplished without even realizing...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, how many others have I not finished yet...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So about twenty more, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If that's all, it might actually be pretty easy to finish them all off if I tried...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! I'm gonna accomplish aaall the stuff I wanted to do, take lots of pictures and make them into an awesome album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First up is... Oh, this one should be good♪
